name: Christmas – Attending Under Protest
title: Christmas – Attending Under Protest Ornament
story: This reindeer ornament is for the relative who came to the family Christmas under protest: a grumpy reindeer in a Santa hat with its arms crossed, and an easy stocking gift for dad, grandpa or the brother-in-law.

The print is a stitch-style reindeer in red, sage and cream, wearing a Santa hat and a deep frown, under ATTENDING UNDER PROTEST in heavy slab capitals on a dark pine-green disc. The art matches our Attending Under Protest hoodie, so the ornament makes a set with the hoodie.

Every family has one person who would rather be on the couch and shows up anyway, arms crossed, hat on. The ornament says it for them without a word, and it looks right on a tree between the glass balls and the felt stars. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the person who is attending under protest. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: Every Christmas has one guest who came for the food and counts the minutes to the exit. The Attending Under Protest ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a grumpy reindeer with its arms crossed in a Santa hat, so the joke reads from across the room and on the tree.
